change_summary: App-only successor to v101.45. (1) FINDING-01 service-worker precache fix carried forward. (2) NEW: notes are now reachable on phone and tablet - the long-press paragraph action bar gains a Note button. Previously the only note affordance was in .para-actions, which is display:none under max-width:768px, gated behind .mode-etude and revealed on :hover, so notes were impossible to create on a touch device. Help text corrected: it had instructed users to enable study marks and look for a per-paragraph button that never appears on mobile. Corpus unchanged.
